upcoming_events.title: Destin Seafood Festival
upcoming_events.description: Three days along the harbor boardwalk: Friday Sept 25 (4–10 PM), Saturday Sept 26 (10 AM–10 PM, closing under fireworks), and Sunday Sept 27 (10 AM–6 PM). Free to attend, with more than 75 food, art and retail vendors, five music stages, and a Kids Zone — Gulf shrimp, crab and grouper straight off the boats. Come early for parking and make a day of the harbor · about a 35-min drive west.

upcoming_events.title: Harvest Wine & Food Festival
upcoming_events.description: 10th annual · four days in WaterColor — Celebrity Winemaker Dinners Thursday, Harvest After Dark Friday, the Grand Tasting Saturday Oct 17 in Cerulean Park (1–4 PM), and a Festival Brunch Sunday · benefits DCWAF children's charities · 10-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Baytowne Beer Festival
upcoming_events.description: 18th annual · Friday night (6–8 PM) brings football on the big screen, bourbon, and bonfires under the stars; Saturday is the Grand Craft Beer Tasting with Seltzer Lane and food pairings · $55 pre-sale, $65 at the gate · 25-min drive west

The Harvest Wine & Food Festival returns to WaterColor Oct 15–18 — four days, a 10-minute drive west, with the Grand Tasting in Cerulean Park on Saturday the 17th.

Those nights aren't ours to give, but Blue Moon is open Tue Sep 29 – Thu Oct 1, three quiet nights before the season turns loud.

Fully equipped kitchen, three king bedrooms, the beach three minutes up the lane.

Mark the festival, book the quiet — link in bio.
